purpose: One owner approval authorizes a large P1C01 production train with many bounded cars. Preparation/source/validation cars may proceed in parallel; runtime-changing cars remain serialized behind exact-head W00 and per-car engine gates.

canon_scope.source_mapping_note: Current runtime P1C01 is a wider vertical-slice composition than source F1-01 alone and already spans party, Ring/Bag End departure setup and road/ferry escape material. This train preserves current runtime topology and does not silently redefine source chapter boundaries.
source_f1_01: locked postcondition: Bilbo leaves and Ring passes to Frodo
source_f1_02: locked postcondition: Frodo leaves the Shire
canon_scope.dialogue_rule: Original game-authored wording only; no verbatim Tolkien or film dialogue.

execution_policy.runtime_serialization: No runtime car starts until its prerequisite exact-head machine gate is green.
forbidden: hard references to heavy production assets
execution_policy.performance_target: 6th-gen i7 / 8 GB RAM / ~2 GB VRAM, DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium, 30 FPS floor target
